facts.fact: EVERSHAG 终于绷不住了，不请自来地去了 KANDINSKY 那间鞋盒般狭小的办公室。
facts.anchor: EVERSHAG finally flipped. She dropped by KANDINSKY’s shoebox of an office unannounced

facts.fact: 她的妆被泪痕冲得面目全非，手里拿着一个马尼拉信封。
facts.anchor: Her makeup was a disaster from what looked like the trails of tears. She was carrying a manila envelope.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 先说她是来告诉 KANDINSKY 自己恨她，随即改口说不恨，只是想成为她那样的人。
facts.anchor: I came to tell you I hate you I mean I don’t really hate you I just want to be you

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 解释：她现在能帮忙，是因为她再也装不下去了。
facts.anchor: Now I can help because I can’t pretend anymore

facts.fact: 信封里是 KRAY 一直在找的东西——关于 Project GOOWIKI 的真相，证明这个项目从头就是个不会成功的假项目。
facts.anchor: it’s the truth the real truth about Project GOOWIKI it’s the proof that it’s all just a big fake program

facts.fact: Marla 是在 Forward Operating Base 爆炸中死去、曾与来自西弗吉尼亚的 Eddie 订婚的人；Eddie 告诉 EVERSHAG，是 Wacker 主张不搜那个人，众人才丧命。
facts.anchor: Eddie told me he heard it was Wacker’s idea not to search the guy and that’s why everybody died

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说 Marla 是她的姐妹，她欠她这份情。
facts.anchor: Marla was my sister I owe her this.

facts.fact: KANDINSKY 震惊地表示自己毫不知情，Marla 只提过有个在这里做事的姐妹，却没说是 EVERSHAG。
facts.anchor: Marla told me she had a sister who worked here, but she never said it was you.
